description: Retrieves the status and result of an asynchronous generation task. Prefer the `poll_url` returned by the create response; `/v1/tasks/{id}` is the canonical fixed status endpoint for video, music, and 3D jobs.

id.description: The async task ID returned by `id` / `task_id`, or embedded in `poll_url`

name: get_task_status
title: Get async task status
